methods_quotes.q: Weighted prevalences of lifetime sexual violence, early sexual debut, and forced sexual initiation were estimated for each country using SAS
prevalences were weighted to the most recent census or population projections to account for the multistage cluster design and nonresponse
Multiple logistic regression models were fit to the data combined across all countries
These models included a fixed effect for country and accounted for survey design, including stratification and clustering
were adjusted to control for age and marital status
Models for transactional sex and infrequent condom use did not include a fixed effect for country as it made the model unstable.
